column1: # What `hygiene exposure` must say about the synthetic repositories beside this
# file, one row per assertion. Read by the fixture section of test/run.
# surface is the loading surface the report must give the path, or `not-listed`
# when no row is about it and it holds no finding. exposure is the verdict for
# the first finding in that file: `likely exposed`, `loading unknown`, `stored`,
# `none` for a file that must hold no finding, or `-` to assert the surface only.
# The negative rows matter more than the positive ones. A file this command
# calls loaded when the tool's documentation does not say so is the worst bug it
# can have, so every row below that reads `not-listed` or `unknown` is load
